paper_title: Training and Evaluating with Human Label Variation An Empirical Study
caption: Soft accuracy and graphs for a binary classification problem on a single example where the true and the predicted judgement for the positive class is 0.5 and q respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the values of two different metrics as a function of the variable q. The x-axis is labeled “q” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “soft accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.0. A blue, solid line represents one metric, starting at 0.57 at q = 0.0, increasing to a peak of 0.90 at q = 0.4, then decreasing to 0.57 at q = 0.8. An orange, solid line represents another metric, starting at 0.76 at q = 0.0, increasing to a peak of 0.93 at q = 0.4, then decreasing to 0.76 at q = 0.8.
